page0.text:
"..."
By the time I leave the Chinese restaurant, it's nearly 4:00 PM.
I don't have any shopping to do, so I can just go home.

page2.text:
...Still, I can't ignore what Kotomine said.
Caster is still alive.
Accordingly, people are still falling into comas.
And on top of that...

page4.text:
I'm surprised how well I took the news that Kotomine was a Master all along.
...Now that I think about it, we've been at odds with each other from the moment we met.
Maybe somewhere in my mind—no, on an even more primal level, I sensed that we would clash with each other.

page6.text:
Anyway, even Kotomine lost his Servant, and I know he wouldn't be careless.
There are three Masters left:
The Master of Assassin, who was lurking at Ryudou Temple; Archer's Master, Tohsaka;
and...

page7.text:
"HEEEEYYYY!
What are you spacing out for, Shirou!?"

page8.text:
"Whoa!?"
B-Berserker's Master, the little girl in front of me!

page9.text:
"I-Illya!? W-w-where the heck did you pop out from!? You scared me!"
"I didn't 'pop out'! I've been calling your name this entire time, but you didn't notice me!"

page10.text:
"Huh...?"
...Oh.
I did notice something ringing in my ears for a while.

page11.text:
"...Wow. You mean all the way back since the shops?"
"Yeah. You were walking and looking really conflicted.
I didn't want to interrupt you so I called you from behind, but you just ignored me and kept going."

page12.text:
"Oh, uh, I was deep in thought. I didn't mean to ignore you..."
"And you didn't come to the park. I waited for you a long time."

page13.text:
Ah...right.
We had an unsaid agreement to meet again at the park this afternoon.
I can't believe I forgot, even if Kotomine needed to talk to me!

page14.text:
"...Sorry. I forgot. I'm really sorry, Illya."
"Hmph! I won't forgive you that easily. I'm really mad, you know."

page15.text:
Illya glares at me grumpily.
...Urgh. What should I do?
I missed our appointment and made her wait. Of course she'd be upset.

page16.text: She won't forgive me unless I show her how sincerely sorry I am. So, I'll...
